feature_name: String Coercion for Filepath Template Objects
description: Update the filepath template system to properly coerce document-related objects (like correspondent, document type, etc.) to their string representation when used in Jinja templates. Currently, when these objects are referenced in templates, they should display their name property but may not be automatically converted to strings.
functional_requirements: Ensure that when document objects (correspondent, document_type, storage_path, etc.) are referenced in filepath Jinja templates, they automatically use their string representation (typically the 'name' field)
Maintain compatibility with existing template syntax and behavior for non-object values
Add appropriate test coverage to verify string coercion works correctly for all relevant document-related objects in templates
